 [STEAM DECK] Fixed an issue where some Steam Deck OLED players were unable to properly set the game resolution to match the external monitor while using the Steam Deck Docking Station.

Game resolution on an external monitor can be changed from the Steam Deck via the Tetris Effect: Connected Properties menu.

To find the Properties menu, navigate to Tetris Effect: Connected in your Steam Deck Library and press the A button. Next, select the cog (⚙️) icon at the far right of the game page then select “Properties…”. From here, you can manually set the Game Resolution via the dropdown to match your external monitor or select “Native”.

notes.title: Free Update - New Effect Modes Coming Feb. 22
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=BiL6U_iONN4;full][/previewyoutube]
A major update to Tetris Effect: Connected arrives on February 22, 2023! As aGameScout details in this video, the Winter 2023 update includes all new modes: Zone Marathon, Single-player Classic Score Attack, Endless Master Mode, and Endless Purify.

Details:

 Classic Score Attack - A single player version is now available in Effect Modes (NTSC/PAL Game Speed included)
 Zone Marathon - A version of Marathon Mode with the Zone mechanic
 Purify Mode - Endless is now an option in Purify Mode
 Master Mode - Endless is now an option in Master Mode


Special thanks to aGameScout for hosting this roundup of all the new modes and features, and guests Yoshimi and Blink from HardDrop for participating!

Download the free update on Feb. 22 to access the new modes.

[ALL] Added an SR Disconnect Penalty status for players that exhibit an abnormally high disconnect rate within RANKED MATCHES. We will be monitoring how well this helps discourage bad actors, and adjust as needed.
[ALL] Adjusted matchmaking so players may not exit the lobby in most competitive RANKED MATCH modes – ZONE BATTLE, SCORE ATTACK, and CLASSIC SCORE ATTACK – once an opponent arrives. Instead, players are automatically “ready”-ed, and the countdown to the match begins.  CONNECTED and CONNECTED VS modes, and all modes within FRIEND MATCH and LOCAL MATCH, behave as they did before.
[PC] Added a "VERY LOW" graphics quality (OPTIONS > GRAPHICS > GRAPHIC QUALITY).

[ALL] Fixed an issue where GAME OVER would appear when all blocks turned to Dark Blocks in PURIFY mode.
Other minor adjustments and bug fixes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40456889/91597054f38524dc2bc7b4c4aad32afe8b37a805.jpg
Greetings Tetris® Effect: Connected players! We have released a new patch that updates the game to version 1.3.1. The most noticeable changes in today’s patch are new Color Assist options designed to help players easily identify MagicMinos among other Tetrimino types, and a change to the default number of Tetriminos displayed in the Next Queue. Please see below for more information on that and the updates made to the Oculus Quest version!


[All] Added options for players with color vision deficiencies – COLOR ASSIST TYPE A, B and C. These can be found in OPTIONS > GAMEPLAY > TETRIMINO COLORS. These new options add patterns to the MagicMinos in CONNECTED/CONNECTED VS, and to TRADITIONAL Tetriminos to make them easier to identify. 
[All]Changed the default NEXT QUEUE display to 4 instead of 1. 
[All]The word TAP is now displayed when reviving in CONNECTED and CONNECTED VS if you fail to TAP 3 times consecutively.  
[All]Fixed an issue in ZONE BATTLE where, in rare cases, Tetriminos would not appear and the game would not progress during the second match when a player had a poor network connection.
[All]Changed the default cursor position in CONNECTED to your highest-cleared Area.
[All]Changed the default cursor position in CONNECTED VS lobbies to BOSS instead of READY. 
Other minor adjustments and bug fixes.

notes.title: CONNECTED 2021 Tetris Effect World Championship Tournament Update
notes.notes:
TE:C COMMUNITY SEASONAL TOURNAMENT STARTS! FINALS ON CTWC CHANNELS!

(Guest post by TE:C Seasonal Tournament organizer Chris Foryst)

With nearly 400 competitors divided into five categories and a staggering thirty-one brackets, the TE:C Seasonal Fall Tournament has now officially begun!

Players will now be tasked with contacting their opponents and arranging matches, which must either be streamed live or observed by one of our Referees. We’ve assembled a great team of trusted Refs who are eager to help out!

But what’s more, we’re proud to announce an amazing partnership with Enhance and CTWC that will take this TE:C tournament to the next level.

The concluding brackets of three categories will determine the final competitors of the inaugural CONNECTED Tetris Effect World Championship annual tournaments. Matches of Classic Score Attack (top 8), Zone Battle (top 8), and Triathlon (top 4) will be shown on the ClassicTetris Twitch channel as part of the 2021 Classic Tetris World Championship in November—the biggest Tetris competition in the world. And the action will be commentated by the man who brought the Boom back into Tetris himself: Chris Tang!

Dear Competitors,

If you are not on the Enhance Discord server, head on over: https://discord.gg/enhance
That’s where we’ll be arranging matches, providing results, and keeping everyone updated, so don’t delay.

Have fun, and good luck!

notes.title: PATCH NOTES V1.2.3
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES V1.2.3

[ALL] Implemented a general failsafe measure to prevent an issue where the game could stall when entering MULTIPLAYER for certain players. (We will be following up with users who reported this problem, but if you had this issue and it is now fixed, or it is still a problem, please submit a support ticket and let us know.)
[ALL] Updated matchmaking code to automatically retry when there is a session error upon joining the lobby. Due to this, joining or creating a room may take as long as 1 minute.  (During times of severe network load, it’s still possible that session errors may occur.) 
[ALL] Updated the matchmaking code to minimize the chances of session errors when transitioning to the match after both players hit Ready. (During times of severe network load it’s still possible that session timeouts may occur.)
[ALL] Fixed an issue where the controller would not vibrate when playing as a client in CONNECTED and CONNECTED VS.
[ALL] Fixed an issue in CONNECTED and CONNECTED VS where Tetriminos in certain areas were not appearing when the Unstable boss Blitz hit.
[ALL] In CONNECTED Multiplayer modes, Tetriminos pre-rotated by this boss’s “No Spin” Blitz now spawn at the same location as Tetriminos pre-rotated by Initial Rotation.
[PC VR] Fixed an issue where Valve Index controls couldn’t be re-bound in SteamVR.
[PC VR] Added Windows MR support (Beta). (Adjusted HP Reverb G2 controller binding.)
(In-game OPTIONS >CUSTOMIZE CONTROLS is not supported but you may change the binding from SteamVR) 
[ALL] Added unique names for 23- and 24-line Zone clears. We’ll leave it to you to find those :)
[PC] In Multiplayer, in addition to using 1 + Arrow keys to emote, you can now also alternately use F2 + Arrow keys to emote. 
[PCVR] Fixed an issue in CONNECTED VS where the player's camera shifted to an odd position when Continue was selected. 
[PC] Fixed an issue where the game would not immediately recognize a second controller at startup in some configurations.

Other minor adjustments and bug fixes.
